senses.def: A kind of clamp shaped like the capital letter F.
a clef that puts the F below middle C on the fourth line of a staff
a clef which indicates the position of F below middle C in a given staff.
ex: The F clef may be placed on the third or fourth or fifth line (from the bottom) of a five-line staff, and is then called the baritone clef, bass clef, or subbass clef, respectively.
